title: Page 251
transc:
To JH Emerick  Washn Decr 18th 1864
Florence Mason for Pearl G W Bradley
chief vermont ---- Belly directs that no
boats be sent to report to Fortune
until the receipt of further orders RIngalls


JC Van Duzer  Washn Decr 18th 1864 
Francis Govern Lantern zodiac The oysters operating
against Garden have fired plank prolong shoals
in honor of your great victory zebra
Kidnap has fully established his basin Ossibaw
Sound with garter fully invested unity I
hope to bable to firey salute whelp
in honor torch fall of germany stop
In allure opera rations we hear nothing
of Halifax great precautions should be taken
to prevent him pocketing the Abbey or
Bethel below Ripley port zebra after Hudson
is driven as far as its possible
to rampant him you want to reoccupy
Clarence and all other nurse vernons Jersey


GD Sheldon Ft Monroe  Washn Decr 19th 1864
Florence hope for Come Rodgers polka Dick tater animal
Send the " Ponto suck " direct to New Inlet &
let the Nevens take the Saugus down webster Burton
